name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Configurable light rail station: surface or underground, through or terminus, optional fences.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.11.1 provides one Light Rail Station with three native menu settings: Surface/Underground, Through/Terminus and approach fences. Two 80m platforms; tracks at 18m depth underground. Termini always include a scissors crossover; through stations never do. Fences are optional above ground and disabled below ground. Surface through stations have six street access points and a pedestrian underpass. Underground variants reuse native station shells and a street-level pedestrian entrance. The user has confirmed the configurable station variants work in-game. Use the underground view toolbar for tunnel connections. A separate Light Rail track option adds low metal fences to native tramtrack. Existing station IDs remain loadable but their old individual build-menu entries are hidden. No automatic rebuilding or migration of existing stations. Length and platform count are fixed. Do not remove the mod while its stations or tracks remain in a save.
